verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a Python package for scripts that control iTerm2 and extend its behavior, billed as "full automation and customization." It also documents AppleScript support for launching the app and opening sessions in new tabs or windows. A community user corroborates that the Python API "lets you touch pretty much everything," so the core of a documented programmatic control API is clearly present. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the API can split panes, send commands, and read screen or command output; any agent-oriented guidance or examples showing a coding agent driving it.
